messages:
Ana (Marketing): Quick sync — webinar on 4/12 needs final competitive bench narrative. Goal: 2 slides (bench + takeaway), 3 soundbites for SDRs, and a routing hook for inbound leads. Can people review?
Gareth (Field): Love the direction. Can we make one slide focused on predictable latency/cost vs cloud APIs? customers ask that first.
Tariq (Sales Ops): Agreed. Also need a one-liner for routing: 'High-throughput inference -> Dedicated' so SDRs can triage.
Maria (Product): I can trim the bench to 3 charts: latency P50/P95, cost per token estimate, and failure/fallback rate. Will share CSV.
Ana (Marketing): Perfect. @Tariq can you draft the SDR soundbites? keep them <140 chars.
Tariq (Sales Ops): Drafts:
- "Redwood: predictable latency at 10ms P50, cost 30% lower on real workloads vs managed cloud endpoints." 
- "Fallbacks & multi-region routing keep apps online when clouds flap." 
Gareth (Field): The first is good but avoid exact numbers unless we have benchmark slide. maybe say 'orders of magnitude' is risky.
Maria (Product): We do have numbers from the internal run. I'll attach source and error bars.
Ana (Marketing): Ok let's keep one variant conservative + one aggressive. Also need inbound routing play: 
```
if lead_round == 'enterprise': route -> dedicated-sales
elif uses_sensitive_data: route -> solutions-eng
else: route -> self-serve nurture
```
Tariq (Sales Ops): That routing snippet is great — will add tags in SFDC: "dedicated-opportunity", "needs-private".
bot-recording: Reminder: add webinar registration link + record session. :robot_face:
Gareth (Field): Timing: can we lock slides by EOD today? Sprint work tomorrow.
Ana (Marketing): EOD works. I'll update the deck and ping for final thumbs up. :thumbsup:
Tariq (Sales Ops): I'll put the SDR snippets into the playbook once slides land.
Maria (Product): Uploaded CSV + brief notes to /confluence/benchmarks — link in DM.
Ana (Marketing): Thanks team. Quick follow-up: please flag any competitor claims we should explicitly rebut (model ownership vs serving).
